arabic text: Kaise darwaazahataau Kaise mohsin ko bachaau Saans\nseene me ruki hai
english translation text: How can I move the door? How can I save Mohsin? My breath\nhas stopped within my chest

arabic text:
haath me jiske mera haath diya tha tumne
Kehke man kunto jise maula kaha tha tumne
Maine har mod pe baba Saath uska hai nibhaaya
Kya mera jurm yahi hai
english translation text:
The one into whose hand you placed my hand,
and of whom you said 'Whoever accepts me as master, accepts him as master'—
Baba, at every turn I remained beside him.
Is this my only crime?

arabic text:
teri ummat ne banaadi hai ye haalat baba
Koi pasli bhi nahi meri salamat baba
Saas leti hu mai jis dam Rukne lagta hai mera dam
Sirf marne ki kami hai
english translation text:
Your nation has reduced me to this state, Baba;
not a single rib remains unharmed, Baba.
Whenever I try to breathe, my breath begins to stop.
Only death remains

arabic text:
kabhi darbaar me peshi ko bulaate hai hame
Kabhi darwaaze pe aa aake sataate hai hame
Mere ye phool se bachhe Puchte hai yahi mujhse
Kya khata hamse hui hai
english translation text:
At times they summon us before the court;
at times they come to our door to torment us.
These flowerlike children ask me only this:
what fault have we committed?

arabic text:
Sharm aati hai bhala tumko bataau kaise
Ye tamacho ke nishaa tumko dikhaau kaise
Tum na pehchaan sakoge Dekhkar mujhko kahoge
Kya meri zahra yahi hai
english translation text:
How can I overcome my shame and tell you?
How can I show you these marks of slaps?
You will not recognise me; when you see me, you will ask:
Is this truly my Zahra?

arabic text:
Ye aziat ye khamoshi nahi dekhi jaati
Mujhse tanhaai ali ki nahi dekhi jaati
Tera paigham sunane Haq wilayat ka batane
Zahra ghar ghar me gayi hai
english translation text:
This pain and this silence can no longer be endured;
I cannot bear Ali's loneliness.
To convey your message and proclaim the truth of wilayah,
Zahra went from door to door
